title: Workspace asset metadata (v1, #48)
description: Machine-readable contract for the YAML frontmatter every reusable workspace asset carries. Delivered by #48; consumed by scripts/check-asset-metadata and (later) the #50 validate/health interface. additionalProperties is true on purpose: this is an overlay on top of a type's own native frontmatter (a skill's agentskills.io name/description, a suite's kind/entry/source), so it validates that the ten shared fields are present and well-formed without rejecting type-specific keys. v0.2 fields (io_contract, compat_range, risk_level, required_capabilities) are named-but-forbidden in v1 and kept out by spec + review, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable, path-independent asset ID; immutable once active. Form type:slug.

type.description: One of the nine asset types.

owner.description: human-id; the accountability convention, not an agent identity.

version.description: The asset's own lifecycle version: full commit SHA / digest (40 or 64 lowercase hex; display may truncate to 6). Distinct from a suite's source version and an artifact's ws-<sha6>.

summary.description: One line: what this asset is.

use_when.description: When to use it (the trigger scenario).

usage.description: How to use it (one line + pointer to body/entry).

dependencies.description: IDs of other assets/tools this one depends on. May be empty.

regression.description: Regression-case ID(s). Non-empty for important assets.

evaluates.description: Evaluator only: the ID of the asset it grades.

evaluator.description: A generating capability: the evaluator ID that scores its output.
